snippet.title: Stars of Icarus | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
Muse Games has shared a new trailer for space battle PvP game Stars of Icarus, alongside the news that it will be launching on PC in Q1 2027.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278950/Stars_of_Icarus/
